blocks.tamil_translation: his Salah is accepted, and his other deeds are also accepted. Whoever's Salah is not accepted (because it was not correct), his other deeds are also not accepted,” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: صَلَّي بِنَا رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ الْعَصْرَ، فَبَصَرَ بِرَجُلٍ يُصَلِّي، فَقَالَ: يَا فُلَانُ اتَّقِ اللهَ أَحْسِنْ صَلَاتَكَ أَتَرَوْنَ أَنِّي لَا أَرَاكُمْ، إِنِّي لأَرَي مِنْ خَلْفِي كَمَا أَرَي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، أَحْسِنُوا صَلَاتَكُمْ وَأَتِمُّوا رُكُوعَكُمْ وَسُجُودَكُمْ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) says, “The Prophet ﷺ led us in the Asr Salah. After that, the Prophet ﷺ saw a man praying. (He said,) O friend, fear Allah! Pray in a beautiful manner!” Did you think that I do not see you? I see what is behind me just as I see what is in front of me. Beautify your Salah, and perform the ruku' and sujud perfectly.”

blocks.text: Explanation:- The Prophet ﷺ seeing what was behind him belongs to the miracles of the Prophet ﷺ called “Mu'jizah”.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ وَائِلِ بْنِ حُجْرٍ ﵁ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ إِذَا رَكَعَ فَرَّجَ أَصَابِعَهُ وَإِذَا سَجَدَ ضَمَّ أَصَابِعَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الكبير واسناده حسن مجمع الزوائد:٢ /٣٢٥
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Wa'il ibn Hujr (RA) narrates, “When making ruku', the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would keep the fingers (of his hands) spread apart, and when making sajdah he would keep his fingers together.”
